guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice_cpu rose from 0.28 to 17.73 (+6238%, z=+525), the largest anomaly in the digest, alongside latency, memory and disk I/O increases, while no other service shows meaningful change. The slowest traces go through frontend->currencyservice->productcatalogservice and never touch emailservice, and there are no warning or error logs, so the link between emailservice and the user-facing alert is not confirmed; CPU is chosen over mem and disk as the primary fault because its deviation is by far the largest.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect the emailservice process or pod for runaway CPU use (e.g. a busy loop), then restart it or scale it out and apply CPU limits. Afterwards, check whether the slow frontend->currencyservice traces persist, since they may have a separate cause.
